title: Saxophones arrive and A and B clarinets
summary: Saxophones came late in the 1900s; early clarinets in A and B; cornet bits; Joe Petit.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: When did the saxophones come into the band? Do you know about? I had a record of it.
There was a fella by the name of Saxon I believe that started that. He was gonna say it's a fake instrument.
Yeah, but when did they start using them here in the city?

I know it was way late in the 1900 I know. Yeah, way late in the 1900 they started that, I'm sure of that. I remember when I first started the clarinet play, they had two clarinets, you remember that? Yeah. They had a car A and a B.
Yeah. You remember that? I've seen the A clarinet.

They had a car A and a B because they couldn't transport. And the cornet with that short they had put them bits on there, remember that? Yeah, I've seen those too. I remember them young boys they knowin' about that. And if anybody told you about Joe Petit, he used to play a vowel trumpet. I knew him, yeah.
I made a record once with him. Did you? He played at that time on the slide.
The slide and he had a key trumpet on there for you.
